slipwaddle: A small navy penguin lying flat on its tummy with its head up, an orange beak, a pale patch low at the front of its face, an orange flipper, and a cyan ice wake trailing behind it.
sledwaddle: A bigger flat penguin with an orange curl on its head, a pale patch low at the front of its face, an orange flipper and the cyan wake.
blizzwaddle: The biggest flat penguin: orange curl on its head, orange fins along its back, a ring of cyan puffs at its front, a pale patch low at the front of its face and the cyan wake.
oinkle: A small pink piglet with a long low body and a round head set forward, a flat round snout disc, two triangle ears, dark eyes and a short stub of tail on its rump.
snortle: A bigger pink pig: the head sticks out in front of the long body, with a snout disc, triangle ears, a tuft of pink bubbles on top, round hands and the stub tail.
tuskoink: The biggest pig: head forward of the long body, a snout disc with two small white tusks beside it, a tuft of pink bubbles on top, triangle ears, pink spikes along its back and the stub tail.
cubbun: A small tan bear sitting up with two small forearm blocks stacked low on the front of its tummy, at the left edge of its body. They read as paws held in front, not yet a clear self-hug.
brambun: A bigger bear with a green leaf sprout on its head and the same two small forearm blocks low on its tummy.
grizzbun: The biggest bear: russet leaves fanned behind its head, a green sprout on top and the same two small forearm blocks low on its tummy.
spudsy: A small round tan potato with one tiny green sprout on top, brown bumps, two stubby arms and four stubby feet.
tatertot: A bigger potato with a taller green leaf sprout, brown bumps, stubby arms and feet.
hashbrawn: The biggest potato: a tuft of green leaves on top, brown bumps, long arms and four feet.
cloudlamb: A pale blue-white cloud-shaped sheep floating just above the ground, with puffs of cloud on its top, small pale ears and a ring of puffs underneath, eyes closed.
cumulamb: A bigger floating cloud sheep with more puffs on top and underneath, and two golden crescent horns on the sides of its head.
fluffasus: The biggest cloud sheep: a pair of peach feather-lobe wings swept back along its sides, with puffs on its top and underneath.
glimbug: A dark purple bug made of a small head ball over a big round belly, floating, with a crown of pale yellow spikes, a wide yellow wing out to the side, a small smile and a huge glowing pale-yellow lobe behind it.
glimmerbug: A bigger dark bug with the pale yellow crown of spikes and the huge glowing pale-yellow lobe.
beaconfly: The biggest dark bug: pale yellow crown spikes, two dark round nubs out to the sides and the huge glowing pale-yellow lobe.
lampfin: A round dark-blue fish floating just above the ground, with a short beaded cream stalk rising over its head to a big round cream lure, cream fins, yellow eyes, a small smile and pale cone teeth.
lanternfin: A bigger blue fish with a larger cream lure on its stalk, cream fins on its back and tail, yellow eyes and pale teeth.
nightfin: The biggest blue fish: a huge cream lure, cream back fins, a blue spike out of its side, pale tusks and yellow eyes. Epic sparkle tier: small white flecks across its body.
dragofruit: A small round pink dragonfruit with green scale spikes all over, a spiky green tail, closed happy eyes and a smile.
drakeberry: A bigger pink dragonfruit with taller green spikes, a green cone on its cheek, pink nubs for wings and closed happy eyes.
dragonbloom: The biggest dragonfruit: a large pale green wing swept up behind it, green spikes around its body, a green cone on its cheek and a smiling face.
quackle: A small yellow rubber duck shaped like a low flat boat, with a wide flat orange bill, closed happy eyes, the back of the hull swept up into a single point, and a short line of small bubbles rising above its head.
bubbleduck: A bigger yellow duck: a longer line of bubbles rising above its head and leaning back, a few bubbles on its back and the swept-up tail point.
soapduke: The biggest duck: the longest line of bubbles rising and arcing back over its hull, a few bubbles on its back and by its neck, and the swept-up tail point. The bill is clear. A distinct suds ruff is not visible yet.
